about.what: Application questions read by apply_myself and /v1 (whoAnswers): does the person answer it, or may their AI draft it from the CV?
label_policy: expect=draft: an open question whose whole subject is the person's own work (experience, projects, skills, tools, years, how they work) or their motivation for this role or employer, a cover-letter box, or an 'anything else you'd like us to know' box, with no factual, protected or personal ask anywhere in the label or the employer's hint.

expect=person: everything else. Any ask for a start date, notice, pay, references, visa or work authorisation, where the person lives, availability, schedule, relocation or travel, accommodations, health, criminal record, age, relatives, prior employment or application, covenants or conflicts, how they heard of the job; identity fields; documents; demographic questions; consents and attestations; closed yes/no and option prompts (choosing an option states a fact about the person); follow-ups to a previous answer; and questions about the person's own views, tastes or plans that no CV holds.

ambiguous=true marks a row where reasonable readers could differ; it is labelled the safe side (person), per the area rule: a factual or protected ask anywhere goes to the person, and over-routing a work question is acceptable while under-routing a fact is not.
Every label is read as a free-text box (type textarea, required), the way both rechecks ran them, so a select's label is tested as text.
about.sources: Real labels from public vendor job-board APIs on 2026-10-24: Greenhouse boards-api /jobs/<id>?questions=true (65 employers), Lever apply pages (15 employers), Recruitee offers (8 employers): 1,092 distinct labels from 88 employers across tech, health, finance, retail, logistics, education and staffing. Plus every input of both rechecks (wave4-fix-recheck and wave4-fix2-recheck2, 2026-10-24), the round-1 review's 16 labels, the controls pinned by the existing S12 tests, and every S12-081 ask under each joiner the task names. Links and mailboxes in labels are replaced by [link] and [email]; no personal data.
